national.asset_total_provenance: PAPER_TOTAL_ALL=2,827,591 / PAPER_TOTAL_NON_TOWER=205,783 from headline_bootstrap_cis_v7. County-rolled-up totals (2639592 / 203984) under-count unmatched counties (~6.6% of assets) — county-master n_assets columns reflect spatial join coverage. Headlines use paper-authoritative totals.
national.denominator_note: Primary: non-tower (n=205,783). All-assets (n=2,827,591) shown for sensitivity per Risk #1 R1.9. Flood metric: any_flood_exposed (FEMA SFHA ∪ SLOSH Cat1 ∪ HTF Minor); SLR 2050 is a separate forward-looking component. Flood CI [4.17, 4.34] is FEMA-SFHA-component-only; no union CI is registered. National any-five is 132,651/205,783 with no registered CI. The national multi-hazard point estimate and CI are pending reconciliation. EQ/WFPI/Hurricane/Winter: bootstrap CIs B=1000 state-stratified asset-level resampling; design effect from county clustering not fully absorbed — intervals are lower bounds. Spatial-cluster bootstrap is Risk #2 backlog.

network_vuln_permutation.effect_size_note: +3-4 pp above random baseline (small but statistically reliable). Reflects that 5H network exposure baseline is itself ~68%.
network_vuln_permutation.supersedes: Deprecated 66.6% from `summary_statistics.ipynb` cells 878-987 — used a stale 10-state, 2-hazard (MMI+heatmap-flood) subset (Rule 7 retraction class-similar to OR=1.71).
network_vuln_permutation.spatial_join_method: kd-tree nearest neighbor per state — node ↔ asset_index
network_vuln_permutation.caveat: This is an EXPOSURE % finding, NOT an outage relationship. Job 1 SLM shows pct_highv × outage NS in both OLS (p=0.768) and SLM (p=0.160).

climate_return.estimand: Annual CONUS asset-location-weighted mean over eligible nClimGrid cells associated with non-tower energy assets; completeness scheme C3.

metrics.meaning: Within-year SD of daily Tavg anomalies

climate_return.claim_boundary: Descriptive climate metrics only: no causal attribution and no inference about infrastructure failure, damage, outage, vulnerability, or risk.
climate_return.c3_annotation: C3 is a borrowed RClimDex-compatible design rule for E1/E2; no ETCCDI or WMO completeness prescription is claimed.

correlations.deprecation_note: Legacy v5 county-level Pearson/Spearman correlations are retained for descriptive backward compatibility only. No combined-family multiplicity or replacement inference is published under the Option B containment gate.
